name: Anomaly cohorts - market.data.fetched by provider and cache_state
purpose: Explain a stale-price report: group provider fetches by provider and cache_state and compare freshness-lag and duration quantiles, so an anomalous cohort (for example provider=X cache_state=stale) stands out from the baseline before drilling into symbols.

hyperdx.select: timestamp, provider, symbol, dataset, exchange, cache_state, freshness_lag_ms, duration_ms, outcome, row_count, error_slug, trace_id

operator_notes: Narrow a suspected symbol with AND symbol:AAPL, or a provider with AND provider:eodhd; keep the first pass unfiltered so the cohort comparison is honest.
The same trace_id also holds the cache-boundary probe (market.cache.accessed) and, for sync-driven fetches, the enclosing huey.task span - paste it into the trace view for the full call chain.
clickhouse_sql:
SELECT
    SpanAttributes['provider'] AS provider,
    SpanAttributes['cache_state'] AS cache_state,
    count() AS sampled_fetches,
    quantile(0.5)(toInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['freshness_lag_ms'])) AS p50_freshness_lag_ms,
    quantile(0.95)(toInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['freshness_lag_ms'])) AS p95_freshness_lag_ms,
    quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['duration_ms'])) AS p95_duration_ms,
    countIf(SpanAttributes['outcome'] = 'failure') AS failures
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE SpanAttributes['event.name'] = 'market.data.fetched'
  AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
GROUP BY provider, cache_state
ORDER BY p95_freshness_lag_ms DESC
expected_result: One row per (provider, cache_state) cohort present in the window, ordered by the worst p95 freshness lag. The stale cohort to investigate is the row with an elevated p95_freshness_lag_ms against its own baseline; symbol is deliberately not in the GROUP BY so the cohort stays visible.
sampling_and_retention: market.data.fetched sits in the 14-day TTL tier (README section 5), and successful fetches are sampled at about OTEL_SAMPLER_SUCCESS_PERCENT percent (default 7); failures (outcome=failure, error_slug) are retained at 100 percent. Reads over the successful bulk are representative, not exhaustive. The cache-boundary event market.cache.accessed has a shorter 7-day tier.
